name: Antidepressants
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of human suffering and emotional struggle, as seen in Jesus' own experience of anguish in Gethsemane (Matthew 26:36) and the assurance that He sympathizes with our weaknesses (Hebrews 4:15). Believers are encouraged to seek God earnestly through prayer (Matthew 7:7) and to support one another in confession and intercession for healing (James 5:16). Ultimately, true peace and courage come from Christ, who has overcome the world and offers hope amid tribulation (John 16:33).
